Ek maangne waale ne waaqe hone waale azaab ka sawaal kiya
Jis ka kaafiron ke haqq mein koi daf'a karne waala nahin hai
Ye bulandiyon waale Khuda ki taraf se hai
Jis ki taraf farishte aur Rooh-ul-Ameen buland hote hain, us ek din mein jis ki miqdaar pachaas hazaar saal ke baraabar hai
Lehaaza aap behtareen sabr se kaam lein
Ye log ise door samajh rahe hain
Aur hum ise qareeb hi dekh rahe hain
Jis din aasmaan pighle hue taambe ke maanind ho jaaega
Aur pahaad dhunke hue oon jaise
Aur koi hamdard kisi hamdard ka pursaan-e-haal na hoga
Woh sab ek doosre ko dikhaaye jaayenge, to mujrim chaahega ke kaash aaj ke din ke azaab ke badle us ki aulaad ko le liya jaaye
Aur biwi aur bhaai ko
Aur us kunbe ko jis mein woh rehta tha
Aur roo-e-zameen ki saari makhlooqaat ko, aur use najaat de di jaaye
Hargiz nahin, ye aatish-e-Jahannam hai
Khaal utaar dene waali
Un sab ko aawaaz de rahi hai jo munh pher kar jaane waale the
Aur jinhon ne maal jama kar ke band kar rakha tha
Be-shak insaan bada laalchi hai
Jab takleef pahunch jaati hai to faryaadi ban jaata hai
Aur jab maal mil jaata hai to bakheel ho jaata hai
Ilaawa un namaaziyon ke
Jo apni namaazon ki paabandi karne waale hain
Aur jin ke amwaal mein ek muqarrara haqq mo'ayyan hai
Maangne waale ke liye aur na maangne waale ke liye
Aur jo log roz-e-Qiyaamat ki tasdeeq karne waale hain
Aur jo apne Parwardigar ke azaab se darne waale hain
Be-shak azaab-e-Parwardigar be-khauf rehne waali cheez nahin hai
Aur jo apni sharmgaahon ki hifaazat karne waale hain
Ilaawa apni biwiyon aur kaneezon ke, ke is par malaamat nahin ki jaati hai
Phir jo is ke ilaawa ka khwaahishmand ho woh hadd se guzar jaane waala hai
Aur jo apni amaanaton aur ahd ka khayaal rakhne waale hain
Aur jo apni gawaahiyon par qaaim rehne waale hain
Aur jo apni namaazon ka khayaal rakhne waale hain
Yahi log jannat mein ba-izzat tareeqe se rehne waale hain
Phir in kaafiron ko kya ho gaya hai ke aap ki taraf bhaage chale aa rahe hain
Daahine baayen se giroh-dar-giroh
Kya in mein se har ek ki tama ye hai ke use Jannat-un-Naeem mein daakhil kar diya jaaye
Hargiz nahin, inhein to maaloom hai ke hum ne inhein kis cheez se paida kiya hai
Main tamaam mashriq o maghrib ke Parwardigar ki qasam kha kar kehta hoon ke hum qudrat rakhne waale hain
Is baat par ke in ke badle in se behtar afraad le aayen aur hum aajiz nahin hain
Lehaaza inhein chhod deejiye, ye apne baatil mein doobe rahein aur khel tamaasha karte rahein yahaan tak ke us din se mulaaqaat karein jis ka waada kiya gaya hai
Jis din ye sab qabron se tezi ke saath niklenge jis tarah kisi parcham ki taraf bhaage ja rahe hon
In ki nigaahein jhuki hongi aur zillat in par chhaai hogi, aur yahi woh din hoga jis ka in se waada kiya gaya hai
